title: The kickoff flow from init to a deliverable
why: Without the steps written down, nothing checks that capture, readiness and the brief join up into one way forward.

title: Anything decided not to build
why: Without it, every new idea in the map looks like part of the first version.

title: Type scale and spacing
why: Each new panel picks its own sizes, so the interface drifts a little with every change.

title: A place for documents and references
why: Images can live in a node, but documents and reference sets still live only in sessions.

title: npm name and license, for when it is shared
why: "groundwork" is taken on npm. It does not matter while this is internal, but it will the day someone else installs it.

title: Lint and format config
why: Without one, style is held only by habit and each session formats a little differently.
